features.name: Data Engineering, Preprocessing & SMOTE Balancing
features.description: Extract raw SQLite higher-layer network log dataset, clean host identifiers, map protocols/categories, and balance classes using SMOTE.

features.name: Baseline Multi-class Machine Learning Classifier
features.description: Train a standard Random Forest multi-class classifier on scaled, SMOTE-balanced O-RAN logs to serve as a baseline threat detector.

features.name: Structured CTI Alert Generation
features.description: Map predicted events to structured JSON/Markdown alerts detailing confidence, feature significance, and classification status for LLM processing.

features.name: LLM-assisted Threat Intelligence Enrichment
features.description: Feed structured alerts to a local/remote LLM to generate rich cyber threat intelligence reports, hazard assessments, and mitigation recommendations.

features.name: SHAP Explainability and Feature Importance
features.description: Compute and visualize SHAP values for model predictions to provide explainable threat intelligence reporting.

features.name: Interactive Demonstration Web Interface
features.description: A web application that demonstrates the complete ML threat prediction and LLM explanation pipeline.

features.name: Comprehensive Final Report
features.description: Write a 6-page final report detailing the methodology, ML results, SHAP integration, and LLM analysis quality for the pipeline.
